successors.name: Kingdom of Scotland
successors.text: 'in 1472, James declared the Norðreyjar to be forfeit': Orkney and Shetland pass to the Scottish crown

ledger.x: c. 872: the earldom is created. Infobox 'Creation date: c. 872'; the page's table of Norse jarls gives c. 892 and says Rognvald Eysteinsson 'is sometimes credited with being the founder of the jarldom of Orkney'; Torf-Einarr 'may be regarded as the first historical earl of Orkney' (c. 895-910). The year is approximate…
1232: a Scottish family takes the earldom.
2 August 1379: 'the jarldom was granted to another grandson of Maol Íosa, Henry Sinclair, by Haakon VI on 2 August 1379'; table rule 1379 to 1401.

certainty.note: The page gives the islands, no frontier or date for the mainland parts.
